models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.why: TeksEdge's stack tuning on one RTX 3090 now has a first-party LLM write-up: 150K context with a q4_0 KV cache at 77.44 tok/s on a llama.cpp PR #27342 build, and a CPU-only PS5 run lands at ~1 token per minute.

engines.quant: Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL + DFlash2 drafter, Q8_0 KV cache, 90K context; native MTP at 100K context was 70.83 tok/s
engines.engine_min_version: development llama.cpp build containing PR #27342 (--spec-type draft-dflash)

engines.quant: Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL + DFlash2 drafter, Q4 KV cache, 120K context, --spec-draft-n-max 4 (larger draft-state buffer costs VRAM)

engines.hardware: Jailbroken PlayStation 5, CPU only (~6 GiB usable)
engines.quant: 2-bit GGUF via PS5LM, the same model the PS5's GPU runs at ~20 tok/s; CPU-only build is limited to ~6 GiB
